svg.title: The JavaScript and Python hosting calls and what each one runs
svg.desc: Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript runs the app's package script: AddJavaScriptApp(name, appDirectory) for a Node app that runs its dev script by default; AddViteApp(name, appDirectory) for a Vite app, including Angular 17 and later, which registers an http endpoint and sets PORT, used for ops-console; AddNodeApp(name, appDirectory, scriptPath) for a Node server started from a script file. Every call takes the app directory as its second argument. Aspire.Hosting.Python uses the .venv folder in the app directory: AddPythonApp(name, appDirectory, scriptPath) for a Python script; AddUvicornApp(name, appDirectory, app) for an ASGI app in module:variable form such as main:app, used for exception-agent; AddPythonModule(name, appDirectory, moduleName) for a module, like python -m; AddPythonExecutable(name, appDirectory, executableName) for a CLI from the virtual environment. WithVirtualEnvironment points at another location.
